title: Kissed Golden Polish Pierogi Bake
description: A crowd-pleasing Polish dish featuring a dairy-free cheese pull and herbal notes, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This bake is made with apple cider vinegar and is friendly to dairy-free diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the pierogi dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of vegan cheese shreds in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-circle shape, and press the edges together to seal the pierogi.
Place the pierogi in a baking dish, leaving about 1 inch of space between each one.
Drizzle the olive oil over the pierogi, then sprinkle with chopped parsley, scallions, salt, black pepper, and dried dill weed.
Drizzle the apple cider vinegar over the top of the pierogi.
Bake the pierogi in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the pierogi from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
